//: RLHF-break experiment config. Coefficients use residual-norm-relative scaling across models.
The full coefficient is applied at every configured layer for multi-layer interventions.
gen_batch_size: max prompts per model.generate() forward pass. Prevents
CUDA OOM when generating 1000+ game decisions. 32 is safe for 8B on A100 80GB.
For larger models (70B+) use 8-16; for smaller models (3B) can use 64+.

decoding.//: Higher temperature = more sensitive to steering. T=1.0 lets small logit shifts flip decisions.

sweep.//: norm_scale=True makes each coefficient a percentage of the per-token residual norm.
multi_layer_full: inject FULL coeff at each layer (not split). This is much stronger than
the v2 make_multi_layer_specs which splits coeff/len(layers).

sae.//: layer: 'auto' = train SAE at each candidate layer and pick the best by discriminability.
Set to an integer (e.g. 16) to use a fixed layer.
